title: From human-centered to social-centered artificial intelligence: Assessing ChatGPT’s impact through disruptive events

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of disruptive events (case studies) in law, education, and work to demonstrate how access to financial, legal, and cultural resources determines the distribution of benefits and harms from AI systems.
Qualitative assessment of the disparate impact of plagiarism detection tools on non-native English speakers within a case study on higher education.
